fields.title: Test Blog Post
author: admin
fields.excerpt: This is a short test post created to check the publishing system and formatting options.
fields.content:
This is a sample blog post written for testing purposes. The goal is to verify that the blog creation and publishing workflow is functioning correctly.

Key points included in this test post:

Ensuring the title, excerpt, and content fields display properly.

Checking how text formatting appears once published.

Confirming that featured images, categories, and tags can be added later.

This post does not contain any real content—it is purely for testing. Once confirmed, you can delete it or replace it with actual blog material.
